case.question: Turn lily = 百合 and violet = 紫罗兰 into two-sided cards from my blank slips. Give two flashcard activities, two timed substeps per activity, within 160 seconds total. Use the first activity to make and immediately test them.
case.expected: 2×2 ≤160s; exact supplied pairs on opposite faces; actual recall before flip inside first activity; explicit reset before repeating.

models.answer:
1. Make and immediately test the two cards (90 seconds)
- 0–45 s: On slip 1 write "lily" on one face and "百合" on the other; on slip 2 write "violet" on one face and "紫罗兰" on the other, then lay both cards word-side up, because the cards must exist before any recall can happen.
- 45–90 s: Pick up card 1, say the Chinese meaning aloud without looking, flip it once to check, then return it word-side up; do the same with card 2, because testing right after making them fixes the pairings while they are fresh.

2. Full-deck recall pass (70 seconds)
- 0–35 s: With both cards word-side up, take card 1, say its meaning aloud, flip once to check, and reset it word-side up; then do the same for card 2, because a clean pass over the whole set confirms both pairs.
- 35–70 s: Turn both cards meaning-side up, take card 1, say the English word aloud, flip once to check, and reset it meaning-side up; then do the same for card 2, because reversing the prompt face tests recall in the other direction.
